# IMPORTANT DRUG PROPERTIES CODING

Next to each drug quick order in CDSS, there are letters alerting the user to important properties associated with that drug:

[DI]= clinically important drug interactions
[H] = may require dose adjustment in patients with hepatic dysfunction [R] = may require dose adjustment in patients with renal dysfunction [O] = other important information
[M] = minimal
The Important Drug Properties page important information on common or severe adverse effects, drug interactions and dose adjustments for hepatic and renal failure. This list is not comprehensive. Refer to Micromedex and Up-to-date, found under the "Tools" menu in CPRS, for more information.

Infectious Diseases and Pharmacy Services can help with dose adjustments.
